note: Printed claims only (Phase 5 Step 6). Wire list image-read from book2-3-4.pdf PDF p.21 (printed p.15): 16 lines match wiresPrinted; the 6Z above the table is a diagram label, not a line. The errata sheet's BOOK II block lists pages 10, 11 and 14 only, so wires = as_printed and errata_applied is empty. Procedure runs from printed p.15 onto p.16 (PDF p.22). Script: all slide switches RIGHT (printed step 1), power ON, switch 4 LEFT (step 2), push pushbutton 6 (step 3); holding it until the dial rests and then releasing it are script choices (the page prints no release). Asserted: the dial reaches contact 4 while pushbutton 6 is down (until, which also matches a pass-through), still rests on 4 after a 10 s window with the button held, and still on 4 10 s after release ('The number 4 is the Decimal Output'). Step 4 is scripted with switch 4 RIGHT and switch 2 LEFT as the 'another number' choice, then pushbutton 6 again; the page states no result for it, so the resting position is not asserted (derived, Step 7). Not asserted: the dial's start position (construction state, not printed), direction of travel, motor speed, anything about release. Rotary geometry, run rate and coast remain profile fallbacks O-R1, O-R3, O-R5.
